rule: MC adds assets to a simple shared folder / upload inbox. Greg/GPM reviews and imports. Vercel is not the easy asset explorer.

roles.KKr: classification, matching, candidate routing, reuse governance
roles.Vercel: deployment system, not casual asset storage

mc_instruction: Drag files into the correct folder.
Message Greg what was uploaded, what it is for, and whether it is final, rough, or idea-only.
Do not edit Vercel, domains, deployments, env vars, or production settings.
release_gate: Uploaded assets are not public until GPM review, KKr classification, required delivery materialization, and BIC production audit PASS.
